newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OSCE Albania envoy says no date yet set on visit.
newsitem.headline: OSCE Albania envoy says no date yet set on visit.

text.p: The Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) special envoy to Albania, Franz Vranitzky, said on Thursday the exact timing of his planned fact-finding visit to Tirana was still open.

"I have had a telephone conversation with President Sali Berisha and we agreed that the OSCE mission will take place at the earliest possible moment. We have agreed to stay in contact," Vranitzky told a news conference at OSCE headquarters in Vienna.
Vranitzky said that the OSCE Troika of foreign ministers would travel to Tirana on Thursday to prepare his visit which he said should take place "in the next few days".
He said Berisha had told him the situation in Albania was "very serious".
"I have no illusion that the mission is not going to be a very difficult one," he said. "We have to coordinate and harmonise rather than polarise."

The OSCE on Tuesday announced that former Austrian chancellor Vranitzky would travel to Albania as soon as possible to assess the situation in the troubled Balkan nation, where a state of emergency has been declared to curb violent unrest in the south of the country.
